definition_en: the state of having little or no hair on the head; also, plainness or bareness of style or land
core_image: 头顶那片亮得能反光的空白
scene: 剃刀划过，理发师吹去碎发。His baldness began at the crown in his thirties.
sceneCN: 这里 baldness 指「秃头」（第 1 个义项：头发脱落的状态）；句意：他三十多岁起就从头顶开始谢顶。

derivatives.zh: 秃的；光秃的；直白的（baldness 的形容词基础）
白头海雕（bald 旧义 white-haired 的存留）

senses.title: Loss of hair on the head
senses.definition: the condition of having little or no scalp hair, natural or shaved
senses.definitionCN: 头皮少发或无发的状态，无论自然脱落还是剃除
senses.why: The root is bald, from a word for white or shining patch.
senses.whyCN: 词根是 bald，源于一个表「白斑、亮斑」的词。

senses.title: Pattern loss, the medical state
senses.definition: in medicine, progressive hair loss, as alopecia or male-pattern baldness
senses.definitionCN: 医学上指进行性脱发，如斑秃、男性型脱发
senses.example: Treatments slow male-pattern baldness but rarely reverse it.
senses.exampleCN: 疗法能延缓男性型脱发，却很少逆转。
senses.why: Clinics named the common condition with the common word.
senses.whyCN: 临床用日常词命名了常见病症。

senses.title: Bareness of land or things
senses.definition: the bare, unadorned state of hills, tires, or furniture
senses.definitionCN: 山丘、轮胎、家具等裸露无饰的状态
senses.example: The baldness of the hilltop showed every rock.
senses.exampleCN: 山顶光秃，每块岩石都一览无余。
senses.why: No hair, no grass, no tread: the metaphor is one bareness.
senses.whyCN: 无发、无草、无胎纹：共享同一个「裸」的隐喻。

senses.title: Plainness of language
senses.definition: of writing or speech, stark plainness without ornament or hedge
senses.definitionCN: 指文字或言语不加修饰、不留余地的朴素
senses.example: The memo's baldness stunned the staff.
senses.exampleCN: 备忘录直白得让员工震惊。
senses.why: Uncovered truth is bald truth: nothing hides it.
senses.whyCN: 赤裸的事实即 bald truth：无一物遮掩。

senses.title: Bluntness that discomforts
senses.definition: frankness so bare it embarrasses or offends
senses.definitionCN: 直白到令人尴尬或冒犯的坦率
senses.example: The baldness of his verdict silenced the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他裁断之直率令满室哑然。
senses.whyCN: 裸露即曝光，曝光即刺痛。

senses.title: The bald eagle's white head
senses.definition: in bald eagle, an older sense of bald meaning white-patched
senses.definitionCN: bald eagle 中保留 bald 的旧义「白斑的」
senses.example: The bald eagle's baldness is feathers, white as snow.
senses.exampleCN: 白头海雕的「秃」其实是雪白的羽毛。
senses.why: An obsolete meaning survives fossilized in the bird's name.
senses.whyCN: 废义在鸟名中化石化保存。

senses.title: Shorn acceptance, a style
senses.definition: deliberate shaving as a look, not a loss
senses.definitionCN: 作为造型的主动剃光，而非脱发
senses.example: His baldness was a decision, razor and mirror.
senses.exampleCN: 他的光头是剃刀与镜子共同的决定。
senses.why: Loss became choice as shaving went mainstream.
senses.whyCN: 随着剃头流行，「失去」变成了「选择」。

senses.title: Figurative stripping of excuses
senses.definition: the exposure of an argument stripped of its padding
senses.definitionCN: 论证被剥去铺垫后的赤裸状态
senses.example: Cross-examination laid bare the baldness of the defense.
senses.exampleCN: 交叉质证让辩方论证的不堪一击暴露无遗。
senses.why: Strip the wig of rhetoric and the scalp shows.
senses.whyCN: 剥去修辞的假发，头皮便露了出来。

intro.en: Baldness is bald plus -ness; bald itself first meant white-patched or shining, probably from a Celtic or Germanic root for a white blaze, and came to mean hairless by the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: baldness 由 bald + -ness 构成；bald 本义「有白斑的、发亮的」，或出自凯尔特或日耳曼语中表「白色斑纹」的词根，14 世纪起转指「无发的」。

items.en: The blaze-root is reconstructed as bhel-, to shine or burn white.
items.cn: 「白亮」词根被重构为 bhel-「发白光、燃烧」。

items.en: Welsh bal and ball meant a white forehead or bald head, the likely source.
items.cn: 威尔士语 bal、ball 意为白额或秃头，是可能的来源。

items.en: Bald meant white-patched, then hairless, by the 1300s.
items.cn: 中古英语 bald 先指有白斑，14 世纪转指无发。

items.en: The older white sense fossilized in the bird's seventeenth-century name.
items.cn: 「白斑」旧义化石化于 17 世纪的鸟名中。

items.en: The figurative plainness sense grew in prose criticism.
items.cn: 16 至 18 世纪「直白无饰」的比喻义在散文批评中发展。

items.en: Baldness names a medical condition, a style, and a critical verdict on prose.
items.cn: 如今 baldness 兼指医学病症、造型选择与文风评语。

note.en: Group one gathers the blaze family and a famous homophone; group two gathers bareness words.
note.cn: 第一组收「白亮」词族与著名同音词；第二组收裸露义场的词。

entries.definition: past of bawl, to shout or wail; sounds identical to bald.
entries.definitionCN: bawl 的过去式，大声喊叫；与 bald 同音异义。

entries.definition: a narrative song; nearly the spelling of baldness's base with an extra l.
entries.definitionCN: 叙事歌谣；与 bald 拼写仅差一个 l，词源无关。

entries.definition: brave; one vowel from bald, a classic ESL slip.
entries.definitionCN: 大胆的；与 bald 仅一元音之差，常见混淆。

entries.definition: the medical term for hair loss.
the general state of being uncovered.
entries.definitionCN: 裸露无覆盖的一般状态。

normalIntro.en: The word is bald plus -ness: take the adjective, add the state.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词就是 bald 加 -ness：形容词加状态。

normal.en: bald, bold, bawled: three ways to trip in spelling.
bald eagle keeps the old sense: white-patched head.
normal.cn: bald eagle 保留旧义：白斑头部。

normal.en: male-pattern baldness is the standard medical phrase.
normal.cn: male-pattern baldness 是标准医学短语。

normal.en: bald statement means plain, unadorned speech.
normal.cn: bald statement 指直白无饰的陈述。

normal.en: Root memory: bhel-, shine; the shiny scalp gave the name.
normal.cn: 词根记忆：bhel-「发亮」，亮头皮由此得名。

abstract.en: See noon light land on a bare crown.
abstract.cn: 看正午的光落在光秃的头顶。

abstract.en: Baldness of prose is the room with the furniture gone.
abstract.cn: 文风的秃，是搬走家具后的空房间。

abstract.en: Feel the wind where hair used to argue with it.
abstract.cn: 感受风吹过头发曾与之争执的地方。

examples.en: He embraced baldness at forty and never looked back.
examples.cn: 他四十岁时坦然接受秃顶，再无回头。

examples.en: The report's baldness left no room for spin.
examples.cn: 报告直白得没有回旋余地。

examples.en: Wind combed the baldness of the moor all afternoon.
examples.cn: 整个下午，风梳理着荒原的光秃。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「暴力的」——暴力的发型，一根头发都不留

root: baldness = bald + -ness。bald 约于 14 世纪见于中古英语，本义「有白斑的、发亮的」，词根可追溯至印欧语 bhel-「发白光」，一般认为经不列颠凯尔特语（威尔士语 bal「白额」）进入英语，后转指「无发的」；旧义「白斑」存留于 bald eagle（白头海雕）。16 世纪起发展出「直白无饰」的比喻义。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses move from the scalp outward: the medical condition, the bare hill, the stark sentence, the uncomfortable truth, the eagle's fossilized white, and the shaved choice.
sensesIntro.cn: 八义项从头皮向外延展：医学病症、光秃的山、直白的句子、刺人的真相、白头海雕的化石化旧义，以及剃发的选择。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright, bare patch where covering used to be.
core.cn: 核心意象：原本有覆盖的地方，如今只剩一块发亮的空白。

branches.en: THE HAIR SIDE: loss, disease, and chosen shaving.
branches.cn: 头发一面：脱落、病症与主动剃除。

branches.en: THE LAND SIDE: grassless hills and worn tires.
branches.cn: 土地一面：无草之丘与磨平的轮胎。

branches.en: THE LANGUAGE SIDE: plainness, bluntness, stripped arguments.
branches.cn: 语言一面：直白、刺人的坦率、被剥净的论证。

branches.en: THE FOSSIL SIDE: the eagle's old white sense.
branches.cn: 化石一面：鹰名中保留的旧义「白」。

branches.en: THE WHITE SIDE: the older meaning kept in the eagle's name.
branches.cn: 白色一面：鹰名中留存的旧义「白」。

intro.en: Baldness is the adjective bald plus the noun suffix -ness.
intro.cn: baldness 由形容词 bald 加名词后缀 -ness 构成。

latinIntro.en: The root is Celtic-Germanic, not Latin; the medical loan alopecia covers the clinical register.
latinIntro.cn: 词根属凯尔特-日耳曼系而非拉丁系；临床语域由拉丁借词 alopecia 承担。
